subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Should #45082 remain the canonical tracker for the remaining Mattermost cron/wake route-context gap, or should maintainers split that part to a broader session-route issue before closing the message-tool half?
rationale: Current main has a partial shipped fix, but the linked PRs cover different halves of the bug and one remaining boundary crosses Mattermost plugin ownership and shared session delivery recovery.

options.title: Keep #45082 canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open until a narrow Mattermost/session fix persists or derives routable deliveryContext for non-direct thread sessions and includes focused cron/wake proof.

options.title: Split cron/wake separately
options.body: Close #45082 only for the message-tool half after moving the cron/heartbeat route-context requirement to a clearly linked canonical issue.

options.title: Use broader session PR
options.body: Treat #77442 as the canonical fix only after it proves the same Mattermost thread-session route with upgrade-safe behavior and real or strong simulated Mattermost evidence.

recommendation.title: Keep #45082 canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a narrow Mattermost/session fix persists or derives routable deliveryContext for non-direct thread sessions and includes focused cron/wake proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is around session delivery-route ownership, where this history shows recent adjacent refactor work.
